TestTheSymbolHalfIsMarkedUnavailableRatherThanLeftEmpty, TestNothingInCrCanFillInAClassification, cli TestReviewAttachesTheHeadSymbolsATestFileReferences pass.

cites() returns false for axis test (or empty axis), so test-axis records are probed or argued. TestATestAdequacyRecordIsExactlyProbedOrArgued asserts both outcomes; cli TestATestAdequacyRecordIsNotGradedCitedByItsCitations drives cr record.

HeadReferences answers References from the head symbol index and is called by cr review (review/attach.go:42) and cr status (status.go:515); a nil index yields Attach's reasoned disclosure. Binary probe with no profile: status prints 'lens test/symbols unavailable ... no profile matched this repository', no profile "". TestReviewAttachesTheHeadSymbolsATestFileReferences and TestEachWayTheSymbolIndexIsMissingHasItsOwnReason (both packages) pass.

authorType tags each comment human or bot from GitHub's __typename; Thread/Comment carry no class field. TestEveryIngestedThreadIsTaggedHumanOrBot, TestOnlyGitHubsOwnBotTypeIsTaggedBot and TestNoIngestedThreadCarriesAClass pass.

Client.Threads pages every review thread (resolved included) with author, body, anchor, resolution and replies (paginated); brief/store.go:68 stores them via WriteThreads into threads.ndjson. TestIngestionKeepsResolvedAndUnresolvedThreadsAlike, TestIngestionFollowsRepliesPastTheFirstPage, TestThreadsAreStoredInThreadsNdjson pass.

openedBy restricts candidates to threads whose opening comment's pullRequestReview id equals the created review's node_id (confirm) or the matched review's id (reconcile); an empty id claims nothing. TestAThreadAnEarlierRoundOpenedIsNotClaimedForThisRound (both paths), TestAnEmptyReviewIDClaimsNoThread and gh's TestEachCommentCarriesTheReviewItWasPostedIn pass. REST node_id == GraphQL review id is documented, not measured; a mismatch stores no thread id, never a wrong one.

Human threads within hunks or threads.proximity_lines (default 10, config.go:88) attached, wired at review/run.go:190; TestABotThreadAndAThreadBeyondTheWindowAreLeftUnattached (review/threads_test.go:63).

retirement stores a record carrying agent-supplied suppressed_by as state suppressed (no cr text match); refuseUnknownThreads (suppressedby.go:33) requires an ingested thread id. TestARecordNamingAThreadIsStoredSuppressedAndIsNeverDrafted asserts no draft block; TestAFindingRepeatingAThreadWordForWordIsStillDrafted proves no cr-side matching. Pass.

Rejection answers only a decodable message with a 4xx status other than 408; anything else goes to postOutcome's unknown branch. Binary probe: a shim answering GitHub's 504 body with '(HTTP 504)' on stderr made cr post --confirm exit 4 naming --reconcile, set post_unresolved, and the next --confirm exited 4 with no second POST. TestAServerErrorOrATimeoutIsAnUnknownOutcome, TestOnlyAClientErrorIsARejection and TestTheStatusIsReadOffWhatGhWroteOnStandardError pass.

Journal.Move checks MayTransition and records record/from/to/actor/head/at; written to transitions.ndjson under the lock. TestEveryTransitionOfTheTableLeavesExactlyOneJournalEntry (finding/journal_test.go:19) plus command-level tests incl. brief/transitions_test.go:18.

TriageEvent carries class, axis, role, grade, rule, severity, PR, round, head; five-name TriageActions; tests TestATriageEventCarriesEverythingSection731Requires (finding/triageevent_test.go:58), TestASeverityEditIsObservableInExactlyOneEvent (cli/triageseverity_test.go:46).

Outcome key (record, pr, round, raised) keeps action as a value, so later outcome replaces earlier; cr post writes ledger outcomes only after post.Create (send.go:134). TestARejectedCallMarksNothingPosted drives rejection then wrong re-triage to one outcome; TestAPostWithoutConfirmWritesNoTriageEvent, TestADraftRaisesWhatItQueuedAndSettlesOnlyItsDiscards pass.
not-here maps to pull-request scope, so a volume discard never silences another PR. TestADiscardForVolumeOnOnePullRequestStillRaisesOnAnother (cli/triagetofit_test.go 46).

Outcomes kept/softened/discarded-not-here/discarded-wrong with CountsAgainstClass true only for softened and wrong; disposition=wrong discards with the body untouched and writes a repository waiver, deletion writes a PR waiver. TestTheFiveTriageVerbsOfSection72 (cli/triageverbs_test.go:62) asserts disposition, waiver scope and statistics contribution for all five verbs plus summary discard counts. Pass.

cr rules check reports three hits and writes no record; cr record with one confirming record stores exactly one, and neither other line is anchored or cited. TestAHitCarriesNoVerdictWhateverItsRuleDeclares covers the register half; rule/norecord_test.go fences record construction out of the rule package.

Contains compares path and head-side hunk ranges (insertion point for delete-only), no side; cr record refuses an anchor outside the unit it names via refuseForeignAnchors (cli/anchorunit.go 28). TestContainmentIsDecidedInHeadCoordinates (contains_test.go 29) and TestARecordAnchoredInOneUnitNamingAnotherIsRefused (cli/anchorunit_test.go 24).

compareClusters: path, then side LEFT<RIGHT (sideRank), then first changed line, stable; single-path Unit; TestUnitIdsOrderLeftBeforeRightAtTheSameLineNumber and TestNoDiffPutsTwoFilesInOneUnit (unit/order_test.go:103-211).

u<n> id, path, hunk ranges, changed count, NormalisedHash over changed lines, formation; TestTheUnitHashIsSection14sValueOverTheUnitsChangedLines pins a literal and asserts change on edit (unit/unit_test.go:127).

Ingest refuses a block outside the queued records before any verb is read. TestAHandWrittenBlockAbortsNamingTheUnknownID drives both cr draft and cr post with an appended hand-written f9 block, asserting exit 1, f9 named, 'no manual-comment channel', and f1 unchanged; TestAHandWrittenBlockIsRefusedBeforeAnyVerbIsRead passes too.

Raise attaches standing notes and withholds the item only when an intent role's cell cites a standing note_id; no text matching; TestARecordedNoteSuppressesTheQuestionOnlyWhenTheAgentSaysSo (review/explained_test.go:93).

mapping.Unmapped (mapping/join.go:19) feeds review.Unmapped items built as KindQuestion; TestAnUnmappedUnitArrivesAsAQuestionBeforeTheForcingRuns (review/unmapped_test.go:43); record-time handling in cli/unmappedintent.go.

After a gh exit 0, post.CreatedReview (review.go:249) errors on non-JSON or a missing node_id and send routes it to postOutcome, whose rejection needs a gh.CommandError, so it is the unknown branch: post_unresolved set, exit 4, nothing marked posted. TestASuccessfulCallWhoseAnswerNamesNoReviewIsAnUnknownOutcome (non-JSON and no node_id, then reconcile adopts) passes.

Round 1's PARTIAL was a misread now pinned by the acceptance itself: a PR with no round exits 4 with a hint naming cr brief (TestACommandReadingPerPRStateBeforeABriefExitsFourNamingBrief, cli/briefed_test.go:128, incl. cr record naming a missing input). FileError maps to exit 3 for a missing caller-named file, a missing state file naming its writer, and a failed write (cli/unreadable_test.go:17,32,46); exit 2 stays for command-line faults.

roundOf returns UnsettledPostError when the head moved and meta carries post_unresolved, before persist (decision 2); cli/brief.go maps it to exit 4 with the reconcile hint. Binary probe: 504 send, new commit and head in the shim, cr brief exit 4, round stayed 1, cr post --reconcile on the moved head adopted, one POST in total. TestABriefOnAMovedHeadIsRefusedWhileAPostIsUnresolved passes.

Built binary run over record/note/status/merge/probe run/unknown command: missing arg, unknown flag, unparseable pr, missing flag value all exit 2 with the usage hint (cobra errors reach exitCodeFor's fallback, root.go:83-88). Measured on the audit binary too.

Binary probes on cr record, each exit 1 naming file line 1 and the field: kind nit, severity urgent, id x1, suggestion_origin human, and duplicate_of on an agent-written file ("written by cr and must not be supplied"); sourceOf (record.go:540-550) admits duplicate_of only when the body digest equals the merge's recorded hash. TestRecordRefusesAValueSection61DoesNotName and TestRecordReadsDuplicateOfOnlyOnTheFileCRMergeWrote pass.
versionOf prefers injected version, falls back to ReadBuildInfo main version, else 'dev'. TestAnUnsetVersionRendersTheDevelopmentMarker, TestAGoInstallOfATagPrintsTheTag (cli/version_test.go:30,53).

VolumeCandidates over the same Sample; stats only reports. TestAnAccurateButUnwantedClassIsAVolumeCandidateAndNotADemotionOne and TestStatsChangesNothingIncludingTheRuleItProposesDemoting (cli/volume_test.go:29,88).

DropWaived removes waived records and returns counts; applied in cr merge (merge.go 265) and cr record (recorddrops.go 60), counts to summary.json. TestAWaivedFindingIsDroppedCountedAndLeavesNoRecord (waived_test.go 57) plus CLI TestARawRoleFileRecordedWithoutMergeStillDropsWaivedAndPostedFindings.
WaiverKeyOf is path, side, class, anchor content_hash (summary excluded). TestAWaiverStopsMatchingOnceTheAnchoredLinesChange (waiver_test.go 211).
Scope derives repository for wrong and pull-request for not-here, refuses other dispositions; disposition stored; no path-prefix widening. TestAWaiverScopeFollowsItsDisposition (waiver_test.go 246).

Waive appends to ~/.cr/waivers/<owner>/<repo>.ndjson or the PR's waivers.ndjson by scope with provenance round/pr/head/reason; RemoveWaiver (301) deletes from either; drops counted at merge/record. TestTheTwoScopesOfSection744LandInTheTwoFilesItNames, TestAWaiverIsReadableAndRemovableFromEitherScope, TestAWaiverRecordsTheRoundThePullRequestTheHeadAndTheReason (waiverstore_test.go 95, 133, 232).
listWaivers reads the repository file always and the PR file only with --pr, with scope and disposition. TestAPullRequestScopedWaiverIsListedOnlyWithPR (cli/waivers_test.go 74).

removeWaiver dispatches wr/wp ids to finding.RemoveWaiver, wp requires --pr and refuses a stale round. TestARemovedWaiverRaisesItsFindingAgainOnTheNextRound (cli/waiversremove_test.go 42) covers both scopes.
